start.authority: User-authorised exact-base conformance repair; isolated synthetic engineering only
start.outcome: A signed-in advocate can replace compromised recovery codes, while failed sensitive authentication attempts receive the existing bounded pause before password verification or credential mutation.
start.finding: Source inspection: register, recover and login consult attempts.verdict, but reauthenticate and recovery-code rotation only record failures. P02 explicitly requires rate-limited sensitive failures to refuse. No runtime reproduction has yet run.

graph.limitation: Dynamic directory dispatch has no statically visible callers; all five HTTP entry points were verified in source.

start.mechanism: One HTTP admission helper reuses nm.domain.attempts policy for all five existing failure-counted authentication doors. Sensitive directory methods receive the observed connection source so one failure contributes once to both account and source counters. No password, proof, code or device cookie is a rate-limit identity.
start.compatibility: Existing thresholds and 15-minute window stay unchanged. Existing sign-in availability policy for unavailable attempt storage remains explicit; this bounded repair does not change deployment policy. Throttling emits 429 and Retry-After; refusal does not spend proof, change recovery generation or revoke sessions.
start.test_contract_correction: Coordinator approved replacing three source-location-only assertions in test_the_door_counts_wrong_answers.py. Their promises are unchanged: admission precedes credential derivation, refusal is 429 rather than 401, and unavailable counter preserves sign-in while health discloses NOT RUNNING. Literal source searches inside api.login cannot follow extraction into the single shared helper; replacements drive the real HTTP path, record consumer calls and assert actual health bytes. Domain policy and existing test names remain unchanged; no threshold or forbidden outcome is weakened.
proof_plan: Existing successful rotation remains positive control
Both sensitive routes stop before their directory consumer at each existing account/source limit
Failures record the observed source exactly once
Source limits transfer across distinct accounts
Changing device or proxy-supplied headers cannot reset source identity
Window expiry permits legitimate use again
Admission bypass mutation restores the forbidden call and is rejected by the same witness
exclusions: No P09 strong-factor or confidential-profile completion claim
No parallel P18/P21 code, real model, live data, external approval or counsel signature
No current-browser proof or PASS until separately executed

build.mechanism: All five routes call _admit_auth_attempt; reauthenticate and rotate pass request.client.host into the existing single failure-recording owner. No authored threshold was changed. A rejected attempt returns 429 plus a positive Retry-After before consumer invocation.
checks: git diff --check on owned code/test files: no whitespace problems
